description:
Capt. Sanjay Gujral – Brief Profile
Capt. Sanjay Gujral is a Master Mariner and senior shipping industry professional with over 37 years of experience in the maritime sector, encompassing both sea-going and shore-based leadership roles.
He spent 15 years at sea with the Anglo-Eastern Group, serving on container vessels, bulk carriers, general cargo ships and tankers,. He holds a Master Mariner Foreign-Going Certificate of Competency issued by the Directorate General of Shipping, India.
After transitioning ashore, he has held senior management and leadership positions across the container shipping and logistics industry. He spent nearly 14 years with Pacific International Lines (PIL), including as Executive Director of PIL Mumbai Pvt. Ltd., with responsibilities spanning commercial management, vessel and terminal operations, business development, logistics, strategy and organisational leadership.
He is currently the Managing Director of CUL Shipping India Pvt. Ltd., the General Agent .
